subject: VMWARE_ESXI_BLACKBOX_OBSERVED_PROFILE_PROMOTION
scope: Promotion receipt for the exact ESXi build/device/QEMU/g101 O0+O4 external Endpoint/Root register-state profile

crossOwnerComparison.comparisonMethod: For each matching sequence and repeat, compare evaluation-input.snapshots, requesterId, and gateStable exactly.

promotedObservableContract.statement: For the exact nested ESXi 8.0.3 build-24280767, system UUID, QEMU 11.0.2 binary, virtio-net-pci 1af4:1041 endpoint, requester 0x0101, g101 gate, and the tested O0/O4 owner envelopes, first/multiple reception, independent Endpoint/Root W1C, B0/B1 OR, and re-arm produced the frozen expected Endpoint/Root register states for three repeats per sequence.
promotedObservableContract.o0Qualification: O0 had Current Owner VMkernel and no active passthrough user, but the target Module Name was None.
promotedObservableContract.o4Qualification: O4 had one runner-created passthrough VM with bound guest driver and heartbeat evidence.
promotedObservableContract.hostLogQualification: Both profiles reported no matching line in strict per-source marker windows; this is not evidence that no interrupt or service path ran.
